entries.test: TASK-025 Pinned Setup title, step and progress > gallery screens phone-320: the accepted state draws Setup’s title and step line pinned over one divider, the equipment beneath it, with nothing read or written
entries.note: Renamed from “…draws Setup’s own pinned title, step and progress over one divider, the equipment scrolling beneath…”: the build’s gallery part ([data-gallery-setup], the route’s own SetupProgress and SetupStepView) does not exist in Round 7’s accepted gallery, whose screens state draws Setup as a static composition. Kept: title and step in the head, the step under the title, one divider (the head’s only), drawn and spanning the frame, below the step, the content starting at it, no sticky overlay, the head still when the content scrolls, the last equipment choice in view below the divider, no horizontal overflow, the URL, no network. Not kept, because the accepted part cannot meet them: the progressbar’s name and values (it has a step line, no progressbar), “the equipment overflows the frame” (its three-choice sample fits), and the tap answering (its choices are a fixed sample). Each is proved on the real route by the four journeys above, and the parity spec compares the route’s head with this part.
